title: Comment “Agent” and I’ll send you a link with $1,000 in credits 👇 This is insane
description: Comment “Agent” and I’ll send you a link with $1,000 in credits 👇 This is insane. You can now build an AI agent that handles all your tasks and works for you 24/7. It’s called Hyperagent, built by the Airtable team. Instead of a normal chatbot where you go back and forth, you deploy an entire team of AI agents that go out and complete any task you want, running on the best models like Fable 5 and GPT 5.6. Here’s how to set it up: 1. Head to Hyperagent and click “Set up your agent” 2. Choose to build your personal agent, hire a team, let the AI interview you, or import from OpenClaw 3. Tell it exactly what you need help with (I said track my weekly priorities and keep all my info confidential) Five minutes later Hyperagent built that agent for me. It connects to all your tools like email, Slack, and calendar, and you can set it to the latest and most powerful models. Then it goes out and completes tasks for you autonomously. Here’s where it gets crazy. There’s an agent command center where you can track all your agents, their operations, and how many times they’ve run. I even launched my own agent onto their marketplace. It’s called the Daily Focus Agent, and it connects to all the tools you use every day to find the exact things you need to get done, then builds the agents to get them done for you. Comment “Agent” and I’ll send you a link with $1,000 in credits plus my custom agent. #HyperagentPartner #AI #AITools #Hyperagent #AIAgent
